title: 第36章 爽啊，一波肥！

第36章 爽啊，一波肥！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

许默躺在地上，浑身剧痛，连抬手的力气都快没了。

他眼睁睁看着那张大嘴越来越近，腥风扑面。

千钧一发之际，一支裹挟着蜘蛛毒液的石箭从高台上破空而来，精准地钉进了领主那只被射瞎的眼窝！

两支箭尖的距离终于够长了。

领主疼得仰头惨嚎，攻势为之一滞。

方芸的手指已经被弓弦勒得鲜血淋漓，但她仍然咬着牙拉满了弓弦，随时准备射出第二箭。

同一瞬间，一道暗红色的残影从火墙后方电射而出。

蜂后！

它悄无声息地降落在领主后腿上一道旧伤处，闪烁着蓝芒的毒针狠狠扎进血肉！

致命的毒素疯狂注入，领主的后腿开始剧烈抽搐，庞大的身躯摇晃了一下。

但领主毕竟是紫色品质的怪物，这种程度的毒素还不足以让它倒下。

它甩动头颅，试图用爪子拍死那只烦人的蜂后。

许默知道，这是最后的机会了。

他拼尽最后的力气，将意识沉入精神，召唤出他一直没有动用的底牌。

蚁巢中那群凶猛的黑蚁！

“给我出来！”

地面开始翻涌，密密麻麻的黑蚁从泥土缝隙中涌出，它们顺着领主受伤的后腿疯狂攀爬，从伤口钻进领主的身体内部！

在血肉中啃咬、撕裂。

领主发出一声变了调的惨叫，前肢拼命挠着地面，试图甩掉这些钻心的虫子，但无济于事。

还不够。

许默颤抖着手从腰间摸出那根他一直没舍得用的眩晕棍。

这是之前在宝箱里开出的低级武器，成功率不到百分之五，但他已经没有别的选择了。

他撑着地面半跪起来，对准领主的头部，狠狠砸了下去。

黑色的电弧在棍尖炸开，击中领主那张扭曲的面孔。

领主的身体猛地一僵，暗紫色的瞳孔开始涣散……它摇晃了两下，轰然跪倒在地，陷入了短暂的眩晕状态。

成了！

就是现在！

Xu Mo was lying on the ground, with severe pain all over his body, and he almost lost the strength to raise his hands.

He watched helplessly as the big mouth got closer and closer, and the fishy wind hit his face.

At the critical moment, a stone arrow filled with spider venom shot through the air from the high platform and accurately nailed the lord's blinded eye socket!

The distance between the two arrow tips was finally long enough.

The lord threw his head back and howled in pain, his offensive stalled.

Fang Yun's fingers were already bloody from being strangled by the bow string, but she still gritted her teeth and fully pulled the bow string, ready to shoot the second arrow at any time.

At the same moment, a dark red afterimage shot out from behind the wall of fire.

Queen bee!

It landed silently on an old wound on the lord's hind leg, and the poisonous needle flashing with blue light pierced the flesh!

The deadly poison was injected crazily, and the lord's hind legs began to twitch violently, and the huge body shook.

But the lord is a purple-quality monster after all, and this level of poison is not enough to make it fall.

It shook its head and tried to kill the annoying queen with its claws.

Xu Mo knew that this was his last chance.

He used his last strength, sinking his consciousness into his spirit, and summoned the trump card that he had not used.

Those ferocious black ants in the ant nest!

"Come out!"

The ground began to churn, and dense black ants poured out from the cracks in the soil. They climbed crazily along the lord's injured hind legs, and penetrated into the lord's body from the wound!

Gnawing and tearing through flesh and blood.

The lord let out a distorted scream and scratched the ground with his forelimbs, trying to shake off these gnawing bugs, but to no avail.

Not enough.

Xu Mo took out the stun stick from his waist with trembling hands that he had never been willing to use.

This was a low-level weapon previously found in the treasure chest, with a success rate of less than 5%, but he had no other choice.

He half-knelt down on the ground, aimed at the lord's head, and hit him hard.

A black arc of electricity exploded at the tip of the stick, hitting the lord's twisted face.

The lord's body stiffened suddenly, and the dark purple pupils began to blur... It shook twice, then fell to its knees suddenly, falling into a brief state of dizziness.

Done!

That's it now!
